name: Scrum
description: Scrum is an agile framework for managing knowledge work, with an emphasis on software development. It is designed for teams of three to nine members, who break their work into actions that can be completed within timeboxed iterations, called 'sprints', no longer than one month and most commonly two weeks, then track progress and re-plan in 15-minute stand-up meetings, called daily scrums.
pointDescription: You have to be able to organize an appointment. This means that you must perform administrative tasks. For example, creating tables and uploading data. This is an important step to complete your sprint.
Soft skills are important: decision making, ability to facilitate. Respect: team members accept what you say.
It is increasingly handling the problems better and better. Effectively relieves the team. Take care to the quality of code and documentation. Moderate during team meetings.
Continuously improve processes . Maintain a proper balance between project owner, scrum team, and management. Start work together the project owner.
Knowing the most of things what the project owner. Undertans the big picture. Dealing with difficult situations. Walk project owner through user stories.

name: UI/UX Design
description: User experience design (UX, UXD, UED or XD) is the process of enhancing user satisfaction with a product by improving the usability, accessibility, and pleasure provided in the interaction with the product. User experience design encompasses traditional human–computer interaction (HCI) design, and extends it by addressing all aspects of a product or service as perceived by users.
